intro v
obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := v
let I := p.asIdeal
have hI : Ideal.is_principal I := by apply Ideal.is_principal_of_height_one hp
let a := (Ideal.ideal_generator I).val
have ha : a ≠ 0 := by contrapose! hI; exact mt Ideal.is_principal_of_zero hI
have habs : Ideal.absNorm I = abs a := by rw [Ideal.absNorm_eq_abs_ideal_generator]; exact rfl
have hnorm : abs a ≠ 0 := by rw habs; exact mt Ideal.absNorm_zero_iff (Ideal.is_principal_of_zero hI)
have hpos : 0 < abs a := by exact_mod_cast hnorm
rw [habs] at hpos
exact hpos
